integrity: All six required documents and a standalone verifier are embedded; byte sizes and SHA-256 digests are computed from their UTF-8 bytes. Claims are self-reviewed, not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Initial closing orientation, independent symmetric instantaneous reversals, no thermal diffusion, one-dimensional finite circle; each fixed integer order only; publication-priority assessment limited to inspected sources.
title: First-collision transform and rare-reversal moment singularity for a run-and-tumble pair on a ring
